title: Spilled pepper everywhere.
text:
Spilled pepper everywhere.. I for the life of me could not figure out how to use this. While it comes with instructions, it doesn't actually show me how to use it. I ended up spilling a great deal of pepper on the counter, not even realizing I was doing so until about ten seconds in.

The finish is great, and the twist is okay with a little bit of resistance, but instructions would've been nice with how to actually use the device.
After I actually used it I had no issues with it leaking.
